Interface ResultsConstants

All Known Implementing Classes:
PAResultsWindow, ResultsWindow
public interface ResultsConstants

Title: Results Constants

Description: All sort of constant text displayed into results window. This is provided here for easy maintainability.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 26-set-2005 Time: 11.06.50 Modified by Ashanka (Nov 09): Desc: Added the description of the Drop Rate Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Patch: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class.
